name: Arden-CL Backpack Elysium
description:
Whether carrying supplies into a combat zone or simply hauling extra gear, the Arden-CL backpack is battle ready and tested. Roussimoff Rehabilitation Systems designed the backpack with a universal core connector allowing it to attach to a wide of variety armors. 

The Elysium edition combines bright gold detailing of winged skulls with a navy blue.
